_comment: Single curated source of truth for the landing (index.html) AND every product dashboard (scripts/build-dashboards.js). Add a prototype by adding an item here; it appears on the product card and in its dashboard on the next push.

items.name: Adaptive Learning (App)
items.desc: Mobile-first adaptive-learning PWA whose hash-routed shell has tabs: Home, Courses, Coach Vic, Practice, Reference. Mastery advances from practice outcomes, and Coach Vic answers only from loaded content with citations.

items.name: PROVEN — Future-State Homepage
items.desc: Editorial landing page for Vector's PROVEN positioning; hero reads 'Proof your people can do the job.' A sticky glass nav tops dark/light sections from endorsing bodies to industry proof and demo-request form.

items.name: Scenario Simulator — Marshall
items.desc: Chat-based scenario simulator, 'The Marshall Scenario,' where learners type free-text replies to an AI partner. Replies are tier-shaded and scored (negative, neutral, strong), closing on framework recap and restart.

items.name: Immersive Panorama
items.desc: Fullscreen 360° panorama viewer on a WebGL canvas with drag-to-look navigation, a loader, and a scene-briefing overlay. Floating chrome adds a scene badge and corner controls, framing a scene-assessment exercise.

items.name: Voice Observation — Highway Spill
items.desc: Voice-driven 360° scene at a Highway 41 tanker rollover, where the learner pans around and records hazard observations via mic. A transcript captures observations, building toward a 'Scene size-up complete' state.

items.name: Fireground Staging — 2-Alarm
items.desc: Leaflet-map staging drill for a 2-alarm fire at Adams & Wabash, where apparatus and hydrant markers drag from a palette. The palette holds engines, ladders, and hydrants; a hidden author mode (?author=1) edits markers.

items.name: All Experiments
items.desc: Index of lesson-presentation experiments grouped into Scenario Simulator, Video Reflection, Basic Interactions, and Custom Code. Each card links to a standalone mock such as chat reflection and peak-BAC.

items.name: Writer Studio — Conversation Practice
items.desc: Three-pane authoring tool where scenario writers fill structured fields instead of raw prompt text. A center form sits between a lint-flagged section nav and inspector tabs: compiled prompt, guardrails, playtest.

items.name: The Eight Learning Phases
items.desc: Print-style reference document, in a cream-and-navy serif layout, titled 'The Eight Learning Phases.' It walks through eight sequential phases from identifying outcomes and needs to credentialing and proving impact.

items.name: Design System Gap Report
items.desc: Audit cataloging design-system component gaps for the check-it v4 prototype. Grouped by primitive — badge, button, tabs, card, alert, progress — plus a build-first priority list and net-new foundations.

items.name: VoiceCheck Feature Promo
items.desc: Feature-release modal announcing VoiceCheck over a daily apparatus check screen. Promotes hands-free voice completion and intent parsing, plus review-before-submit highlights and a 'Maybe later' dismiss.

items.name: Sandbox Home
items.desc: Home screen for the Checklist Sandbox, sidebar splitting Checklists and Fleet. Lists checklists with deployment cadence beside a vehicle fleet table and a detail panel of specs, status, and deployed checklists.

items.name: Checklist Builder
items.desc: Checklist Builder for configuring a checklist and deploying it to vehicles. Includes a settings panel, a filterable add-vehicles picker, and several empty states like no deployments, no matches, and nothing to add.

items.name: Block Creator
items.desc: Block Creator for authoring checklist blocks from draggable step cards. Each step card sets label, type, required flag, options, and numeric fields via add/delete controls, drag reordering, and a blast dialog.

items.name: Apparatus Rig Check: Engine 7
items.desc: Guided run of an Engine 7 apparatus rig check, stepped one card at a time. A progress strip tracks steps with pass/deficiency badges, plus skippable optional blocks, a carried banner, and a verify-summary review.

items.name: Launcher and window placement (V1 to V3)
items.desc: Vectoria AI chat launcher shown in three placements over an Insights dashboard backdrop. A version switcher toggles V1 (top-nav icon, window top-right), V2 (bottom-right FAB), and V3 (top-nav icon, window bottom-right).

items.name: FAB surface: Training Plan
items.desc: Learner training-plan page carrying the Fin chat FAB bottom-right, listing assigned items by urgency. Count tiles (Assigned, In progress, Overdue, Completed) top Overdue and Due soon sections with Resume/Start actions.

items.name: FAB surface: Catalog
items.desc: Course catalog page hosting the Fin chat FAB bottom-right, with a search field, category filter chips, and card grid. Course cards carry category, title, meta, rating, and an Enroll button, with a grid/list view toggle.

items.name: Assigned Training Wizard
items.desc: Full-page wizard for assigning training, opening on Select Training with search, filters, and a selection panel. A five-step stepper runs Select Training, Select Assignees, Scheduling, Optional Settings, and Review.

items.name: Component Redesigns
items.desc: Interactive gallery of EHS LMS component redesign options, responsive to hover and click. It compares nav-item, launch-button, and card-tile variants like ghost buttons, left-border active states, and solid blue tiles.

items.name: Manage Qualifications
items.desc: AG Grid list of qualifications with completion criteria, order, requirement count, status, and location columns. A create control offers Build with AI or Create manually; row actions raise deactivate and delete dialogs.

items.name: Manage Requirements
items.desc: AG Grid list of requirements within the Qualifications area, with sortable columns and status indicators. Row names link into AI or manual requirement builders, and actions open a deactivate confirmation dialog.

items.name: Manage Activities
items.desc: AG Grid list of learning activities that feed qualifications, with type and status columns. Create actions add activities or requirements; row links open Edit Activity or Learning Studio, plus deactivate/delete dialogs.

items.name: Edit Activity
items.desc: Activity editor split into Details, Delivery, Attributes, and Attachments tabs. Covers activity version history, recomplete settings, thumbnail and attachment uploads, and an Edit in Learning Studio handoff.

items.name: AI Qualification Builder
items.desc: Qualification builder pairing a program canvas with a conversational assistant panel. Canvas sections cover Requirements, Activities, and Settings, with a Generating Your Program state and add-existing pickers.

items.name: Manual Qualification Builder
items.desc: Same qualification builder as the AI variant, minus the conversational panel, built manually. Editors add existing requirements and activities, configure Settings, and view the Qualification Audit History.

items.name: AI Requirement Builder
items.desc: Requirement builder pairing an activities canvas with a conversational assistant panel. The panel drafts requirements from prompts, while Add Existing Activity inserts items directly.

items.name: Manual Requirement Builder
items.desc: Manual requirement builder that defines a requirement by picking its activities, without the AI assistant. A Select Activities picker adds items, Share this requirement distributes it, and the Audit History logs changes.

items.name: Location Navigation
items.desc: Administration Dashboard showing a redesigned location switcher that opens a clickable location tree. A 'Now viewing' indicator tracks the current scope above dashboard tiles like Compliance Rate and task panels.

items.name: Mobile App
items.desc: Interactive mobile app prototype in a phone frame spanning 17 screens, from org lookup and sign-in to the learner home. A bottom tab bar (Home, Discover, Records, Profile) links My Training, course sections, and quizzes.

items.name: Report Redesign V1 (Scheduling)
items.desc: Qualification Reporting redesign (v1) as report cards for Completion Status and Activity Exception. Each card offers date-preset filters, entity pickers, bar/line/pie toggles, and Schedule/Recipient delivery blocks.

items.name: Report Redesign V2 (Management Pages)
items.rel: Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V2 With Management Pages/Report Redesign with CRUD.html
items.desc: Qualification Reporting redesign (v2) that extends v1 with CRUD management pages for saved views and schedules. A Views & Schedules section lists Saved Views and Scheduled Reports with create, edit, and delete actions.

items.name: Tasklist Report
items.desc: Insights Tasklist Report presenting task sign-off tracking in a filterable table. Columns cover task description, instructor and employee sign-off, and comments, with Report Filters and complete/incomplete status.

items.name: Table Breakpoints Reference
items.desc: Reference documenting how the report table adapts across seven responsive breakpoints. Includes an interactive simulator, a side-by-side comparison, a column-width spec, and a five-stage scale of column shedding.

items.name: Select Qualifications Modal
items.desc: Sizing spec for the Select Qualifications modal, previewing it at Large Desktop, Desktop, Tablet Landscape, and Mobile. Each preview shows qualification selection with Add Selected and Cancel, plus a breakpoint summary.

items.name: Mobile App — Frames
items.desc: Static reference sheet laying every EHS mobile screen side by side as flat frames. Covers Home, Records, and the full JSA wizard—Start, Basic Info, Facility Search, Steps, Add Step, Checklist, and Signature.

items.name: Mobile App — Main (current scope)
items.desc: Interactive EHS mobile prototype for the current build scope, navigated via screen pills. Includes Home and Records with status/type filter pills, a JSA creation wizard, offline sync, and conflict-resolution dialogs.

items.name: Mobile App — Blue Sky (user testing)
items.desc: Exploratory, forward-looking version of the EHS mobile app built for user testing. Layers AI, voice, and photo-capture features onto the main flow, plus extra JSA screens, a Create hub, and a Compliance Calendar.

items.name: Mobile App — Records
items.desc: Standalone prototype of the EHS mobile Records list and its filtering. Features select mode, a filter bottom-sheet with status and type pills, offline and empty-state toggles, and an 'already submitted' dialog.

items.name: Homepage
items.desc: Vector EHS web home dashboard greeting the user by name. Stacks modules for Recommended Actions, Recent Activity, a Compliance Calendar, and Recent Reports.

items.name: Incident Investigation
items.desc: IndustrySafe incident investigation form for case FY26-00004. Sections cover Basic Information, Incident Details, Vehicle Involved, Witnesses, Responders, Incident Analysis, Recommended Training, and History.

items.name: Incident Investigation Summary
items.desc: Read-only summary of investigation FY26-00004, a hazardous material spill. Shows fact tiles for status, severity and risk, plus narrative field blocks, involved people, vehicle details, root cause, and suggested courses.

items.name: Print to PDF Customization
items.desc: Interactive document editor (V3) for customizing EHS print-to-PDF output. Supports in-place editing, drag-to-reorder and resize of blocks, inline comments, signature and corrective-action sections, and zoom/fit paging.

items.name: Safety Training Insights
items.desc: React dashboard (recharts, lucide) linking EHS safety data to Convergence training, led by KPI tiles. A facility risk table, compliance and incident trend charts, and recommended-training cards you can share or dismiss.

items.name: Navigation Prototype
items.desc: Navigation-shell prototype unifying Vector EHS and Convergence Training, with a collapsible left sidebar of expandable nav items. The top bar carries module tabs, a location switcher, and an app-switcher menu.

items.name: Civic Seal Tracker
items.desc: V2 tracker for the NY Seal of Civic Readiness, criteria grouped by Civic Knowledge and Participation. Rows show earned credits and linked badges, with a drill-down drawer for detail and a modal for evidence submission.

items.name: Experience Creation Wizard
items.desc: Multi-step wizard for creating a Pathways experience, driven by a side stepper. Steps cover General, Scheduling, Additional Settings, Save Location, and Review, with tabbed panels and timelog toggles.

items.name: Experience Settings
items.desc: Settings page for a Pathways experience centered on a field-configuration matrix. The matrix table sets each field's visibility and requiredness — hidden, optional, or required — with a Save Changes action.

items.name: Experience Sharing
items.desc: Sharing and permissions view for a Pathways experience with experience tabs. A share table lists people and their role capabilities, a drawer adds new shares, and lifecycle actions cover clone, archive, and inactivate.

items.name: Experience Edit
items.desc: Edit form for a Pathways experience with tabbed field groups. Sections cover main information, key stakeholders, and template field overrides, using toggle rows, inherited district defaults, and an overview drawer.

items.name: Async Reports
items.desc: SafeLMS Reports workspace built around asynchronous report generation, with type tabs like Quick, Completions, Training and Assessments. Includes a Schedule panel with date range and a results log offering per-row Export and View.

items.name: Dashboard
items.desc: SafeLMS prototype index that serves as the product's dashboard landing page. Auto-generated from products.json, it renders prototype cards and a recent-changes feed sourced from meta.json.

items.name: LS Integration Warning
items.desc: SafeLMS Courses page demonstrating a Learning Studio integration-warning modal. Online/Custom tabs and row kebab menus launch a 'Learning Studio Launcher' confirm dialog, with a V1/V2 switch comparing modal variants.

items.name: Reports
items.desc: Standard SafeLMS Reports view with report-type tabs—Quick, Completions by employee and time, Training, Assessments, and Survey. Includes a Schedule Report section and paginated results with First/Last navigation.

items.name: Timeout Modal
items.desc: Session timeout warning modal for ticket SAFELMS-30656, shown over a dimmed SafeLMS backdrop. Warns before expiry with a countdown and Continue/Extend actions, and includes logged-out and 'session extended' states.

items.name: OSHA Reporting
items.desc: SafeLMS OSHA Reporting dashboard, one tab alongside Completions and Impact Insights. Features a Completion Status Overview, status-distribution and action-needed panels, and a filterable report table with a column picker.

items.name: test
items.desc: Scratch/test area for trying out the Vector Web Components and design-toolbox workflow. Contains only a single Vaadin primary button wired up with the VWC core, theme styles, and toolbox.js.

items.name: Course Recommendations
items.desc: Rubric-based teacher evaluation that generates on-demand AI course recommendations for scored growth areas. Domains carry rubric ratings feeding a gaps list, with recommendation cards to add to a cart, discard, or vary.

items.name: Course Recommendations (Single Page)
items.desc: Single-page variant of the rubric teacher evaluation with AI course recommendations. Domains render as accordions on one scroll, with rubric ratings, a gaps-driven recommendation cart, and a submit gate.

items.name: Course Recommendations (Flat Form)
items.desc: Flat-form variant rendering the evaluation as a linear list of questions. Offers varied field types, a configure-assignment modal, attachment options, and an apply-signature step, alongside course recommendations.

items.name: Evaluation Users (Redesign)
items.desc: Redesigned Evaluation Users page pairing a month calendar with evaluation cards. Calendar mode tabs switch views while cards show status, timestamps, attachments, and forms like a mid-year self-reflection draft.

items.name: Event Forms
items.desc: Request form for a restricted event, with event info, scheduling, custom questions and attachments. Drawers add sessions and permission rules, a role switcher flips author/approver views, and an add-presenter dialog.

items.name: Event Forms (v2)
items.desc: Second iteration of the event request form, reworking session scheduling. Adds recurring sessions (weekly with occurrence counts and date ranges), session titles, default max attendees, and waitlist settings.

items.name: Manage Activities
items.desc: Manage Activities dashboard listing PD activities with status, credits, and cost. A filters dialog narrows the list by action and state — needs approval, accepted, new feedback — with attendance detail rows.

items.name: Manage Attendance
items.desc: Attendance roster for a multi-session event with expandable per-session sub-tables. An advanced-filters panel narrows by department, grade, and enrollment, with feedback-scope options and a release-credits action.

items.name: Overview
items.desc: Overview dashboard indexing the Evaluations UX prototypes as a grid of cards. Each card shows title, path, and status like in-progress or review, linking to mocks such as course recs, event forms, and reports.

items.name: Reports
items.desc: EV+ Reports view showing Ratings by Question Over Time, charted per evaluated user. An advanced-filters panel scopes by department, region, subject, and date range, with a catalog drawer for switching reports.

items.name: Report Nav Explorations
items.desc: Interaction explorations for report navigation, comparing three ways to switch reports. Compares a top-drawer header expansion, a content-bounded floating sheet, and an inline content takeover.

items.name: Report Nav Explorations v2
items.desc: V2 wireframes refining the header-plus-top-drawer report navigation pattern. Annotated states show header anatomy, the drawer closed/opening/open, category tabs, and prev/next tooltips as explanatory wireframes.

items.name: AI Search Engine Dashboard
items.desc: CallBack dashboard for the AI callback search-and-ranking engine, built in React. A left product nav (Crew Scheduling, CallBacks, Rankings, Force Hire) frames dashboard cards, schedule templates, and AI ranking scenarios.

items.name: Dashboard
items.desc: Scheduling prototype index acting as the product's dashboard landing page. Auto-generated from products.json, it lays out prototype cards and a recent-changes feed pulled from meta.json.

items.name: Deployment
items.desc: Crew Scheduling deployments tool for building and filling assignments. Covers Edit Assignments, a Manage Templates tabbed view, and a Create New Deployment flow that selects qualifiers and employees to fill positions.

items.name: Event Indicator
items.desc: Scheduling calendar concept from ticket UX-2474 exploring shift event indicators. A team-grouped resource grid offers day/week/month views, filters, open-slot cells, and badge and dot indicators on shifts.

items.name: Rules Engine
items.desc: Isolated CallBack Rules Engine screen (React) for building callback approaches and rules. Pairs an AI assistant, freeform input and suggestion chips with scenario generation and a live preview mode for testing changes.

items.name: Theme Colors
items.desc: System Settings screen for theming a Scheduling app's appearance. Sections cover background and accent color, gradient and custom-image backgrounds, density preference, text display size, and navigation transparency.

items.name: Versioning Test
items.desc: Scratch area for exercising the versioning workflow, not a real feature. Holds a placeholder 'Dashboard Wireframe' with dummy Metric A–D tiles, an overview and records table, and a V1/V2 (Dark) version toggle.

items.name: test
items.desc: Scratch/test area for trying the versioning and toolbox workflow rather than a designed feature. Its V1/V2 entries load a full CallBack Rules Engine build with nav, dashboard, and rankings as sample content.

items.name: Create Tenant from Product
items.desc: Form for creating a Keystone tenant from an existing product tenant. Filters by product and state to find a product tenant, then maps it into Keystone tenant details with an auto-generated UUID.

items.name: Create User from Product
items.desc: Form for creating a Keystone user from an existing product user. Uses filters to locate a source product user, then populates Keystone user fields, mapping the product identity into a new record.

items.name: Tenant Details
items.desc: Detail view of a single Keystone tenant's information and product mappings. A Product Mappings table links product tenants, and a slide-in drawer with state filter and search picks the tenant to map.

items.name: Tenant List
items.desc: Keystone Admin landing with tabs for Keystone Tenants and Keystone Users. The tenants table is sortable and searchable by name, city, or state, with an empty 'no tenants found' state.

items.name: User Details
items.desc: Detail view of a Keystone user with product mappings and associated tenants. Drawers handle selecting a mapped product user and managing associated tenants, alongside editable name/ID fields and an actions menu.

items.name: Comment Panel
items.desc: Threaded comment-panel component across UI states: count badge, All/Open/Resolved filters, @-mention threads, and a compose footer. A live demo sits beside empty, loading, expanded-reply, and resolved snapshots.

items.name: Media Gen Form
items.desc: States gallery for an AI media-generation modal spanning prompt, preview, edit, and animate steps with loading states. A V1/V2 toggle swaps light stacked modals for a dark split layout with image pane and parameter form.

items.name: Content App
items.desc: Dark-themed mobile learner app built on a full-screen, TikTok-style vertical feed of microlearning cards with progress and quick actions. Bottom nav spans Feed, Explore, Learn, and Profile, plus a finish-your-collection nudge banner.

items.name: Author — Create
items.desc: Full-page form for creating an author, split into a public Profile section and an internal-only Vendor/Business section. Repeatable degree/publication rows, multiselect pickers, and a sticky bar requiring only Author Name.

items.name: Author Profile
items.desc: Author detail page with a photo header, status badge, and a Public Profile block: bio, subjects, credentials, degrees, publications. Each section toggles view/edit inline, beside a sidebar Actions card.

items.name: Authors
items.desc: Authors directory with search, three filters, and a sortable grid of name, credentials, subject domain, content count, and status. A split Quick-add button opens a drawer or the full create form, with a paginator below.

items.name: Content Detail — Customer
items.desc: User-owned custom course detail (Fire Safety, Acme Corp) with meta chips, description, authors, and three editable variants. Variant rows carry edit/duplicate/history/archive actions and an editable Catalog Details form.

items.name: Content Detail — Vector
items.desc: Read-only detail for a Vector-provided course (Lockout/Tagout Safety): meta chips, description, authors, and two locked variants. The sidebar's Copy-to-My-Library action is the only edit path, with view-only Catalog Details.

items.name: Content Library
items.desc: Content Library landing: a searchable grid of courses and modules with title, type, ownership, status, duration, and modified columns. Filters for type, ownership, status, and pending updates sit above the paginated table.

items.name: Global Assets
items.desc: Assets manager with tabs for Image Assets, Templates, Themes, Avatars, and Voices, plus an Upload Asset action. Templates and avatars show Vector cards, themes use color-swatch sets, and voices are a coming-soon state.

items.name: Overview
items.desc: Lightweight Content Portal entry page showing a spinner and title before auto-redirecting to the Content Library. A meta-refresh drives the redirect, with a manual click-here fallback link if it doesn't fire.

items.name: Settings
items.desc: Settings page centered on an AI Guidelines card: a guideline textarea with a 2,000-char counter and save-with-confirm. A More Settings grid previews coming-soon cards: content lifecycle, asset approval, and author roles.

items.name: Variant Detail — User
items.desc: Editable user variant (Acme Corp — Millbrook): audience callout, description, authors, and Learning Object sections tagged shared or unique. Sidebar has Edit/Create/Archive actions and version history with a revert dialog.

items.name: Variant Detail — Vector
items.desc: Read-only Vector variant (Vector Default — US English): locked banner, description, authors, and shared Learning Object sections. Sidebar offers Copy to My Library and Preview as Learner, with a read-only version history.

items.name: Scenario Manager
items.desc: Branching-scenario editor with a node-graph canvas and a side panel for Nodes, Outcomes, and Citations under an AI-search header. Its toolbar adds nodes, suggests AI branches, auto-arranges, and validates, above a play-through simulator.

items.name: Content Portal Home (Overview)
items.desc: Personalized Content Portal home with a greeting, a hero promoting the AI builder, and a Start-something-new row of content-type tiles. Below, sections cover recent work, fresh templates, and a link to the full library.

items.name: Content Creation Workflow
items.desc: Entry screen for a generalized creation flow with a hero and content-type tiles: Course, Learning Activity, Simulation, Scenario. Selecting a type then a path (AI-guided, template, or combined) routes to the guided builder.

items.name: Course Overview
items.desc: Course-authoring workspace with a header (code, version, save, Publish) and an icon rail: Content, Detail, Assessment, Survey. A Course Structure panel holds drag-reorderable sections beside the editable content view.

items.name: Legal Confirmation
items.desc: Terms & Conditions acceptance modal that requires scrolling to the bottom before the agree control unlocks. A draggable prototype widget switches between first-time terms and an updated-terms variant with a warning banner.

items.name: Object Manager
items.desc: Scene-based Learning Object editor with a preview canvas, timeline track, transcript, and AI audio generation. Panels cover scenes, properties, knowledge checks, citations, and a scope-aware comment panel with mentions.

items.name: Step 1 Phonetic Update
items.desc: Generate Audio modal with a transcript field, an Edit-Phonetic-Text reveal, a voice picker, and an audio-preview row. Transcript edits reset the synced phonetic text, and Add to Scene stays disabled until audio is generated.

items.name: WIP — Component Sandbox
items.desc: Scratch sandbox for component and pattern explorations, currently a custom searchable dropdown with a pinned Add-new-item action. A DS Usage Notes disclosure flags its deliberate divergence from vaadin-combo-box.

items.name: Component Explorer
items.desc: Minimal starter page that loads the Vector Web Components core, themes, Open Sans, and Font Awesome, but ships an empty body. It serves as a blank component-explorer scaffold, ready for dropping in VWC elements.

items.name: Notifications
items.desc: Notification design exploration covering toasts/snackbars, system banners, and in-app items with rich actions. Variants span solid/filled and tinted/soft styles, size and structural options, and snackbar positioning.

items.name: Gallery
items.desc: Gap gallery comparing the v4 prototype's patterns against shipping Vector v1.5.1 components. Rows span badges, buttons, inputs, cards/KPIs, navigation, empty states, banners, an entity panel, and a glass theme.

items.name: Reference
items.desc: Spec-style expansion reference for the Vector Design System, using the badge/status pill as its example. It maps current state, a form × surface matrix per intent, decorative tagging colors, and an expansion summary.

items.name: Overview
items.desc: Simple demo: a 'Target Solutions' heading and an 'Open Table' button that launches a modal dialog. The modal holds a five-row data table with ID, Name, Description, and Status columns, closing via X or backdrop click.
